title: Forwarded newsletters stay readable
changes: Substack newsletters forwarded or sent to your @einkreader.app address keep their whole text, with their title, byline and images, instead of being replaced by the publication's subscribe page.
Pictures that link to a larger version show as pictures, not as a stray "!".

title: Author profiles on the web
changes: On the web feedback page, an author's name or avatar opens their profile.

title: Reading settings: font, margins and page turns
changes: New Reading section in Settings, with a live preview: text size, margins, and four fonts (Serif, Literata, Sans-serif, Atkinson Hyperlegible).
Turn pages instead of scrolling: articles move a screen at a time, with "← Page 2 / 5 →" at the bottom. Swipes and page keys turn pages too.
The text size is now remembered.

title: Know when someone answers your feedback
changes: The feedback icon shows how many new replies and reactions your feedback got; threads with news are marked "new".
Feedback is now readable on the web at einkreader.app/feedback, and there is a contact page.

title: Backups that don't freeze the app
changes: Backing up a large library no longer makes the app unresponsive; a progress bar shows how far along it is.
Settings show when your last backup was made, and how big it was.

title: Ready for the Play Store
changes: The Play Store version is signed for release.
Tidier website addresses: /privacy, /opensource, /brand.

title: X sign-in built into the Play Store version
changes: The Play Store version connects to X (Twitter) without needing your own developer key.

title: Feedback loads by itself
changes: The feedback list loads and refreshes on its own.
Screenshots are attached to article feedback only when you ask, and open full screen.
A more compact Inbox, with an "Other senders" filter.

title: Account deletion
changes: You can delete your profile and your @einkreader.app address, from the app or the website.
Fixed sharing by email.

title: Faster feedback, simpler setup
changes: Feedback opens instantly from what's saved on your device.
Adding a source starts by picking its type: RSS, X or Nostr.
Creating a profile starts with your address, checked as you type.
Inbox comes first in the filters and in your sources.

title: Instant feedback posting
changes: Posting feedback is instant; offline, it waits in the outbox.
A more compact feedback list.
Tapping a name opens a fuller profile with their highlights and feedback.

title: A quieter feedback link
changes: The feedback button under articles became a discreet line of text.
A simpler feedback form that shows clearly who you post as.

title: The Inbox
changes: Links, newsletters and PDFs emailed to your @einkreader.app address land in a new Inbox, filtered by sender.
Mail from new senders waits for you to accept it.

title: Feedback with screenshots
changes: Send feedback with a subject, a link and a screenshot, right from any article.

title: Public feedback
changes: Share ideas and bugs with everyone from the app, reply in threads and react with emoji.
A brand page with logos and images at einkreader.app/brand.

title: Lighter X bookmark sync
changes: X bookmarks are fetched 10 at a time, and only as far back as needed.

title: X sign-in fixed
changes: Fixed signing in to X on e-ink devices getting stuck in a loop.
Only new bookmarks are fetched; the debug log is quieter.

title: Instant link menu
changes: Tapping a link opens its menu instantly, even offline.
Errors that need X reconnected offer a button to do it.
The Read tab is sorted by when you read each article.

title: Better X posts and articles
changes: Links to X posts show the post itself; more articles extract cleanly.

title: Resume reading follows your filters
changes: Resume reading sits below the filters and shows only what they select.

title: Readable X errors
changes: Problems with X are explained in plain sentences.

title: Source errors you can see
changes: A source that fails to update shows a warning, and X can be reconnected from its feed.

title: Older websites
changes: Articles from table-based sites (like paulgraham.com) extract properly.

title: Quotes keep their shape
changes: Paragraph breaks and list lines survive in quotes.

title: Instant sharing
changes: Sharing a highlight closes the dialog at once and publishes in the background.

title: Simpler sharing
changes: A button at the end of an article shares all your highlights from it.

title: Download status
changes: Articles show whether they're downloaded; the Read and Highlights tabs filter by source.

title: Tweets that share links
changes: A short tweet sharing a link brings in the linked story.

title: Friendlier offline messages
changes: Clear messages when you're offline, everywhere; an Advanced section in Settings.

title: Cleaner articles
changes: Stray style code no longer shows up as text in articles.

title: Tables
changes: Tables in articles render properly.

title: A calmer Settings
changes: Settings are organized into sections, one screen each.

title: Profile polish
changes: Small fixes to how profiles look.

title: Reader fixes
changes: Hidden page content stays hidden; highlights work across bold text.

title: Profile editor
changes: A clearer profile editor.

title: Accents fixed
changes: Pages without a declared encoding no longer show garbled accents; copy an article's link from the share menu.

title: Your profile, as others see it
changes: The profile screen mirrors your public page, with an editable address.

title: Public pages
changes: Simpler public profile pages with a link for each story, and ways to subscribe.

title: Several profiles
changes: Use several profiles and switch between them, each with its own library.
Writing a note and sharing a highlight happen in one place.

title: Tweets keep their line breaks
changes: Long tweets keep their paragraphs and lists.

title: Search filters
changes: Narrow search results by source, author and more.

title: Search
changes: Search across sources, authors, titles, content and highlights.

title: X bookmarks by author
changes: Filter X bookmarks by author.

title: All your X bookmarks
changes: Your whole X bookmark history is imported, resuming where it stopped.

title: A new home
changes: A redesigned home screen; swipe right on an item to read it.
Highlighting is instant, with a menu right where you tapped.

title: Your own address
changes: A free name@einkreader.app address, and a public page for your highlights.
Email articles to your reading feed.
X threads arrive whole, with their images.

title: A tidier library folder
changes: Saved articles are organized by year and source.

title: Update fix
changes: Fixed the app failing to open after updating to 0.2.0 (no data was lost).

title: Nostr
changes: Follow Nostr profiles: their notes, long reads and bookmarks.
An optional public profile to share highlights with comments.
Anything that can't be sent right away waits in an outbox.

title: Less newsletter clutter
changes: Newsletter calls to action are hidden in articles.

title: Highlights in your files
changes: Highlights stay in sync with a highlights file in your library folder.

title: Folders in the feed
changes: Folders expand right in the feed's filters.

title: Organizing sources
changes: Drag sources into folders; see each source's description and stats.

title: Share highlights on X
changes: Post highlights to X, sized to fit your plan.

title: Folders and sharing
changes: Organize sources into folders; a share menu for articles.

title: Read later
changes: Save any link to read later, from other apps or the clipboard.

title: Save links from articles
changes: Save links found inside articles to read later.

title: Resume where you left off
changes: The app remembers where you stopped reading.

title: First public beta
changes: Read RSS feeds, X bookmarks and Nostr offline, built for e-ink screens.
Highlights, favorites, swipe between articles, and full backups.
